# Check the inputs

## Your task

Validate your inputs before analysis.

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/01-check-inputs.R
```

**Expected output:** `results/tables/input-checks.tsv` with 24 samples, 15 features, two groups, and PASS.

Checks cover required columns, unique identifiers, exact matches, valid counts, groups, and positive totals. Failures stop the analysis.

## Use your own data

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/01-check-inputs.R data/my-study results/my-study
```

::: {.callout-note}
A PASS confirms table structure, not scientific readiness. Review contamination, controls, pairing, batch, sampling effort, and study design separately.
:::

## Check before continuing

Resolve errors and record corrections in your decision log. Ask AI to explain an error, then verify its suggestion before editing data.
